caxton-printed-handbill-ad.description: A man in a long dark robe, short dark hair, in profile, pins a blank white sheet of paper to a stone pillar in a vaulted stone arcade. Behind him at left is a wooden screw printing press. Through an arch, Gothic tracery windows and spires of a church are visible. Dark, painterly oil style, warm candlelit tones; the painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border. No legible text.

boston-news-letter-first-ad.description: A man in an apron and rolled sleeves leans over a wooden table in a dim workshop, lifting a sheet of paper beside a large wooden hand press. An oil lamp glows in the middle distance and a moonlit window behind him shows ship masts. Shelves, type cases and stacked papers fill the room, and a few blurred marks are on the paper but no legible text.

quaker-oats-man-trademark.description: A smiling older man with grey shoulder-length hair, a black wide-brimmed hat and a dark buttoned coat with a white cravat holds open a burlap sack of grain in a dim, rustic wooden interior. Steam rises from a vat or cistern in the background, and a beam and wall are visible. The image is an oil-painting style portrait filling the whole frame with no visible text, border or frame.

pears-soap-bubbles-ad.description: A curly-haired child with brown ringlets, in a dark green velvet suit with white lace collar and cuffs, looks up at a single soap bubble drifting above a clay pipe held in one hand. In front of the child on a wooden table sit a ceramic bowl of soapy water and an amber bar of soap, with a cracked terracotta pot and a green plant at the right edge. The background is a dark, painterly brown-black wall. No text, frame or border is visible, and the scene is calm and non-graphic.

kodak-you-press-the-button.description: A woman in a dark high-collared Victorian-style dress looks down at a small dark leather box camera held at her waist, her thumb on its top. Behind her, out of focus on a grassy lawn at dusk under trees, a man in a bowler hat, a woman and two children stand together as if posing. The scene is an oil-painting style image with no visible text, border or frame.

michelin-man-bibendum.description: A cream-coloured figure made of stacked rubber rings, with round spectacles and a lit cigar, raises a glass filled with nails and shards toward the viewer. Dark oil-painting background with candles, a glass decanter and shadowy figures; tyres and nails lie on the table in the foreground. No text or frame visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

morton-salt-when-it-rains.description: A small child in a tan raincoat and dark rubber boots walks left through heavy rain, holding a closed-down dark umbrella with a hooked handle in one hand. Under the other arm is a dark cylindrical canister, and a bright stream of white grains or water pours from its open top down past the child's legs and onto a wet, reflective puddle. The background is dark and stormy with diagonal rain streaks, in a painterly, moody style. No visible text, letters, frame or border.

mr-peanut-created.description: A walking anthropomorphic peanut with a face, white gloves, thin legs, black top hat, monocle and a cane, on a dark wooden counter. Behind it are glass jars and bowls of nuts, with a burlap sack and a scoop at right. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with warm light.

betty-crocker-created.description: A still life painting in warm, dark oil style. A cream-coloured cloth flour sack tied at the top stands at left on a wooden table. Beside it is a yellow glazed bowl with a wooden spoon. In the centre is a round frosted cake on a white plate with a slice missing. At right is a tall stack of envelopes with handwritten addresses and stamps, with an ink bottle and dip pen in front. A dark wooden cabinet fills the background. No people are visible.

burma-shave-roadside-signs.description: A dark, painterly night-or-dusk scene of a black early-automobile sedan with lit headlamps driving toward the viewer on a muddy dirt road. On the right, a row of small rectangular blank white boards on wooden posts recedes along the verge, with dark trees and grass around them. There is no visible lettering on the boards.

wheaties-first-singing-jingle.description: Four men in dark suits and vests sing with open mouths at a single vintage microphone on a stand, under one hanging lamp against a dark curtained backdrop. A wooden cabinet on the right holds a bowl of cereal with a spoon and a white pitcher. The style is oil-painting, with 1920s to 1930s dress and no visible text or frame.

coca-cola-santa-claus-ads.description: A jolly, white-bearded man in a red suit with white fur trim tilts his head back to drink from a glass bottle by a brick fireplace. Stockings hang on the mantel, a holly garland is across the top, and a burlap sack of toys (a doll, a drum, wrapped gifts) sits at his feet. The style is a loose oil-painting look with dark edges and warm firelight, filling the whole square.

elsie-the-cow-mascot.description: An oil-painting style scene of a brown-and-white cow with a garland of yellow daisies around its neck, its head filling the centre-right. Behind it and to the left are glass milk bottles on a wooden counter, and at the bottom are more bottles, some filled with milk. The background shows a dusky fairground at night with striped tents, string lights, and silhouetted people in period-looking clothing. No visible text, frame or wounds.

smokey-bear-debuts.description: A brown bear in a gray wide-brimmed campaign hat and denim overalls leans over a campfire in a dark pine forest, pouring water from a metal bucket onto glowing embers while smoke rises. Painterly, oil-like style; no visible text or frame, and the painting fills the square image edge to edge.

a-diamond-is-forever-slogan.description: A dark, painterly still life. An open black velvet ring box sits on a dim surface, with a diamond solitaire ring standing upright in it. A burst of gold sparks radiates from the stone against a shadowed brown background. No people, no visible text, and the painting runs edge to edge.

tony-the-tiger-mascot.description: A cartoon tiger with a red neckerchief stands on two legs with one fist raised, grinning, beside a large bowl of golden flakes with a spoon in it. Dark brown painterly background, flakes and sparkles flying up, painted oil-style rendering filling the frame edge to edge with no visible text or frame.

marlboro-man-campaign.description: A weathered man in a dark wide-brimmed hat and worn brown jacket leans over, cupping his hands around a lit cigarette while a horse stands beside him. The background is a dim, open plain under a dusky cloudy sky with low hills, painted in a loose oil style. No visible text, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge.

vw-think-small-ad.description: Dark, murky oil painting in brown and black tones filling the whole image. A single small rounded car, resembling a vintage Beetle, sits lit by a spotlight in the lower left corner. The rest is a large expanse of empty, dim brushwork with no figures, text or border.

ronald-mcdonald-debuts.description: A dark oil painting of a TV studio: two vintage boxy cameras on pedestals flank a wooden stool lit by a single spotlight. On the stool sit a cardboard box with arch-shaped handles, a crumpled paper cup with a small red mark, and a burger on a plate. Stage lights hang above and bleacher benches sit behind. No people, no frame, no readable text, nothing graphic.

pillsbury-doughboy-debuts.description: A painterly, dimly lit kitchen still life. A small smiling dough figure in a white chef's hat and neckerchief sits on a floured wooden counter beside a torn tube of pale dough wrapped in foil and paper. A finger from the right edge pokes his round belly. Behind are a mixing bowl, a rolling pin and a dark cast-iron skillet. No text or frame is visible.

coke-hilltop-teach-the-world.description: A group of young people with 1970s hairstyles and clothes stand on a grassy hillside under a cloudy sky, singing with open mouths. Many hold glass soda bottles. The painting is oil-style and fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

i-love-new-york-campaign.description: A white T-shirt with a large red heart hangs on a rack at a street clothing stall. Behind it, a city street with parked cars and lit windows runs toward a tall skyscraper with a stepped top, under an overcast sky. A man in a flat cap and dark coat stands among hanging jackets on the right. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

apple-1984-super-bowl-ad.description: A woman in a white tank top and red shorts swings a sledgehammer in a dim, smoky industrial hall. A large projected screen on the left shows a stern man's face. On the right, rows of shaven-headed people in grey uniforms sit facing the screen. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

nike-just-do-it-slogan.description: A pair of worn grey and dark sneakers with loose laces sits on a dark gravelly road at dusk. The road recedes toward a low hill under an orange-tinged sky with silhouetted trees and a utility pole on the left. A swoosh-like mark is visible on one shoe. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text, border or frame.

got-milk-campaign.description: A dark, warmly lit oil-style still life on a kitchen counter: an upright crumpled paper milk carton, a half-eaten peanut butter sandwich in front, and an empty glass on the right. A stove, cabinets and utensil jar sit in shadow behind. No letters, numbers, signature, border or frame are visible; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

apple-think-different-campaign.description: A dim, oil-painted room with a figure in dark silhouette seated at a desk, facing a glowing beige CRT computer monitor and a beige desktop tower. Behind them, a wall of gilt-framed portrait paintings of men and a few women in dark suits, their faces mostly lost in shadow. Papers and a pen cup sit on the desk, and the lighting is low, with the monitor the brightest element.

budweiser-whassup-ad.description: A painted living room scene with a worn plaid-cushioned couch, a brick-style mobile phone and a corded handset on the cushions, and a rumpled blanket. A CRT television on the right shows an American football game. A brown beer bottle, a glass and a bowl of snacks sit on a side table, with tangled cords on the floor. The style is dark oil-painting realism, with no people in view.

dove-evolution-film.description: A dark, moody oil-style painting of a dressing table at night. A large billboard on a pole towers above it, showing a woman's face with dramatic eye makeup and glossy lips against a pale background. The table holds makeup brushes in a cup, aerosol cans, lipsticks, compacts and loose brushes, with a warm lamp glowing on the left. An open laptop on the right shows a photo-editing interface. Nothing is gory and no text is legible.

old-spice-man-your-man-could-smell-like.description: A red plastic bottle of body wash sits on a dark wet ledge in the foreground. Behind it, a glass shower stall fills with steam, with a chrome showerhead and handset. Through an open doorway on the right, a black horse stands in the surf of a sunlit beach under a stormy sky. The style is dark, painterly and moody, with no visible text.

coinbase-bouncing-qr-code-ad.description: A dim, dark room with a crowd of people in the foreground holding up smartphones, all pointed at a large flat-screen TV. The TV screen is black with a single glowing square of blocky black-and-white QR-style pixels, outlined in a soft blue and pink glow. The scene is painted in a dark, expressive oil style, with pictures hanging on the walls and a speaker and shelves at the sides. No readable letters or numbers are visible.
